item.title: Agents are just prompts done right
item.description:
Open a terminal. Type claude. That’s it — you’re doing prompt engineering now.

The /init command sets context. The prompt you type next becomes the agent. There’s no framework, no config file, no abstraction layer. Just you, a terminal, and a well-crafted sentence telling the machine what to do.

The animation above walks through the whole thing: launching Claude Code, initializing a project, and creating an agent that scans your old teaching materials for connections you missed. The agent writes its discoveries as markdown in ideas/ — structured, searchable, ready to become your next post.
